scope: Test-harness storage change only. The managed 35ed runtime and its performance acceptance are unchanged; passing one owned application workflow does not accept every browser or GUI clipboard workflow.

implementation.storage: Fresh random 0700 child under the current user private cache acceptance directory; previous fixtures are never searched, reused or deleted by allocation.
implementation.filesystem_admission: The Linux 64-bit guest program checks opened directory filesystem types and rejects tmpfs and ramfs. Existing canonical owned home/cache parents must not be group/world writable; the acceptance parent must be 0700. No symlink parent is followed.
implementation.reserve_scope: A one-GiB available-space admission reserve, not a retained-byte cap, quota, preallocation, continued free-space guarantee or automatic retention limit.
implementation.transport: Fixed isolated Python program with one of two literal prefixes on bounded stdin and a validated bounded path reply; caller retains its existing transport.

ownership_and_retention.scope: Existing captured-unit/PID-birth/profile-lease checks continue to authorize retirement. Successful runs remove only owned fixtures through their existing cleanup. Failed or uncertain fixtures can remain on disk for inspection; there is no automatic sweep or pruning.

coverage: fresh random owned private directory without old-fixture reuse/removal
fixed isolated program/stdin and bounded reply validation
local_validation.scope: Local pure/mock and owned temporary-directory checks. Full suite result is the owner-executed 842fbc9 source run; eight focused allocator tests were independently rerun.

singular_http_native.scope: One real owned Chromium profile on one virtual output. Native pointer/socket/CLI Open each loads exactly one fresh owned loopback HTTP document through %u; declared Action still opens two local documents. Existing focus/authority and exact cleanup checks pass with the new disk-backed allocator.

gui_clipboard_native.scope: One owned Chromium textarea and native Notes on one virtual output, with real keyboard clipboard transfer in both directions, Unicode/combining/emoji/CJK text, selection replacement, blank lines and trailing LF. Existing checkpoint, settings, wallpaper/source/exports, widget layout, clipboard history, monitor/workspace/cursor, idle marker and owned profile cleanup restore; the normal desktop is stable for 35 seconds after one expected guarded restart.
not_covered: automatic Notes restore after host crash

limits: The implemented filesystem check rejects tmpfs and ramfs; it does not certify every possible RAM-backed block-device configuration.
The reserve is checked before allocation and is not a browser-profile size bound. Failed fixtures can still accumulate on disk and require separately authorized review/retirement.
The earlier retired-payload cleanup, shape diagnostic, video resource/presentation observations and older native clipboard results retain their own sources and scopes.
No new resource/performance, default-handler, external-navigation, direct activation-token-consumption, physical-device or arbitrary third-party application acceptance is claimed.
native_duration_scope: Owner-observed harness durations are bounded test execution times, not performance benchmarks.

normal_after_gui_read_only_verification.scope: Fresh independent normal-state capture after the one expected guarded GUI restoration restart. No same-PID claim; private settings digests, paths and process identities are not published.
